title: The FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin before 7.5.56.7212 does not sanitize and escape a user-supplied value…
description: The FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin versions prior to 7.5.56.7212 contain a vulnerability where user-supplied input is not properly sanitized and escaped before being output on a page. This flaw allows users with Contributor role or higher to inject arbitrary scripts that execute when viewed by users with higher privileges.
